operations.summary: Get the items (and their statuses) of a single bulk action.
operations.notes: Read-only POST. Returns the per-item results of a bulk action so you can track upload/import progress. Path params: store_ids (comma-separated AutoDS store IDs), bulk_action_id (the integer id from the bulk_action object returned when the job was started, e.g. by upload_products). Body holds optional filter/pagination. Response: {results: [...], total_results: int}. Each result carries an integer `status`: 1=created and 2=in_progress are not final states — keep polling; 3=finished, 4=canceled and 99=error are final. The job is over when no item is left at 1 or 2, which is what you must check: a successful read here says the progress query worked, never that the work succeeded. A finished item carries the created product's id in `autods_product_id`; an item at 99 carries `error_reason` / `error_code`. A mixed batch (some 3, some 99) is the normal outcome, not a failed call — report both halves rather than resubmitting the batch. Polling cadence, because there is no push channel and every poll costs you a turn: wait ~10s after the write before the first poll, then poll every ~15s, and stop after 10 attempts — about ~2.5 min at that cadence. Polling faster than that returns the same unfinished answer and buys nothing. On reaching the ceiling with items still at 1 or 2, report what is unfinished and its last status — do not keep polling and do not report the import as done. The parent action carries an integer `type`: 1=create_draft, 2=import_to_marketplace, 3=import_untracked, 4=products_update, 5=products_delete, 6=drafts_delete, 7=orders_update, 8=drafts_update, 9=products_relist, 10=conversations_update.

parameters.name: store_ids
parameters.description: AutoDS store IDs if more than one should be comma separated
